rules.source_quote: All individual account holders of participating banks/ Post office in the age group of 18 to 70 years are entitled to join.

Individual bank/ Post office account holders of the participating banks/ Post office aged between 18 and 70 years who give their consent to join / enable auto-debit, as per the above modality, will be enrolled into the scheme.
All bank account holders other than institutional account holders are eligible for subscribing to PMSBY scheme.
rules.note: The passage does not explicitly mention Aadhaar but implies eligibility for account holders.

rules.source_quote: Any NRI having an eligible bank account with a bank branch located in India is eligible for purchase of PMSBY cover subject to fulfillment of the terms and conditions relating to the scheme.
On attaining 70 years or the end of the policy tenure of the subscriber already enrolled in the scheme.

In case a member is covered through more than one account and premium is received by the insurance company inadvertently, insurance cover will be restricted to one account and the premium shall be liable to be forfeited.
rules.note: The passage does not explicitly mention failure or dropout but implies restrictions on multiple accounts.
